name: anyfree2copilot
description: Use the free models behind OpenCode Zen, Cline and AtomCode (AtomGit CodingPlan) directly in Copilot Chat — agent mode, tool calling, MCP, all of it.

anyfree2copilot.sources.atomcode.enabled.description: Expose AtomCode (AtomGit CodingPlan) free models. Requires the AtomCode CLI to be logged in (`atomcode login`).

anyfree2copilot.sources.opencode.enabled.description: Expose OpenCode Zen anonymous free-lane models. No account needed.

anyfree2copilot.sources.cline.enabled.description: Expose Cline free models. Requires a signed-in Cline desktop app.

anyfree2copilot.atomcode.home.description: AtomCode home directory. Empty = ~/.atomcode (honours the ATOMCODE_HOME environment variable).

anyfree2copilot.atomcode.hosts.description: AtomGit LLM gateway hosts, tried in order across failover attempts.

anyfree2copilot.atomcode.clientVersion.description: Value sent as X-AtomCode-Ver. Empty = the version the signing scheme was verified against (5.2.1).

anyfree2copilot.atomcode.allowRefresh.description: Allow minting a fresh access token via acs.atomgit.com/oauth/refresh when auth.toml's token is stale.

anyfree2copilot.atomcode.models.description: AtomCode model id allowlist. Empty = every AtomGit model discovered in the CLI's config.toml (fallback: the built-in verified roster).

anyfree2copilot.opencode.refreshSeconds.description: How often the OpenCode Zen free-model catalog is refreshed, in seconds.

anyfree2copilot.cline.home.description: Cline desktop home directory. Empty = ~/.cline (honours the CLINE_HOME environment variable).

anyfree2copilot.cline.clientType.description: Value sent as X-CLIENT-TYPE / X-PLATFORM. Empty = cline-sdk.

anyfree2copilot.cline.clientVersion.description: Value sent as X-CLIENT-VERSION / X-PLATFORM-VERSION. Empty = 4.1.22.

anyfree2copilot.cline.allowRefresh.description: Allow minting a fresh access token via the Cline refresh endpoint when providers.json's token is stale (does not kick the desktop session).

anyfree2copilot.cline.includeClinePass.description: Also expose the subscription-gated `clinePass` model bucket (403s without an active subscription).

anyfree2copilot.debug.description: Verbose logging to the 'Free Models for Copilot' output channel.
